name: How long does it take to repair a wood fence panel?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to repair a wood fence panel?

acceptedAnswer.text: The time required to repair a wood fence panel depends on the complexity and size of the repair. Minor fixes, such as replacing a few pickets, might take a few hours. More extensive repairs involving structural elements could take a full day or longer. We provide an estimated timeline with our repair quote.
acceptedAnswer.description: Repair time for a wood fence panel varies from a few hours for minor fixes to a day or more for extensive damage.
